design_philosophy: Premium Indian Fintech SaaS. Combines Apple-level simplicity (rounded forms, soft shadows, heavy whitespace) with Stripe-quality data visualization (crisp charts, deep navy contrasts, electric accents). Dense but breathable 'Control Room' dashboard strategy.

scale.currency_large: text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary font-headings

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (E1 Standard) paired with 'Control Room' Grid.

surfaces.glass_header: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50 dark:bg-[#0B132B]/70 dark:border-slate-800/50
surfaces.ai_panel: relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 to-emerald-50 dark:from-indigo-950/20 dark:to-emerald-950/20 rounded-2xl border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 dark:bg-accent dark:text-accent-foreground dark:hover:bg-accent/90 h-11 px-6 rounded-xl font-medium transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 h-11 px-6 rounded-xl font-medium transition-all
buttons.outline: border border-slate-200 bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 dark:border-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 h-11 px-6 rounded-xl font-medium transition-all
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 h-11 px-6 rounded-xl transition-all

inputs.default: h-12 bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 rounded-xl focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:border-transparent dark:bg-[#1A2642] dark:border-slate-700

charts.guidelines: Use Recharts. Use fluid container widths. Area charts MUST use deep-to-transparent gradients. Tooltips must have custom rich rendering matching the card surface style.
charts.metrics: Always format currency as Indian Rupees (₹) using Lakh (L) and Crore (Cr) notation. E.g., ₹2.5L, ₹1.2Cr.

navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom navigation bar (h-16) with glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md) and active state indicator (accent color).
navigation.desktop: Left sidebar (w-64) with high-contrast active states. Top nav for global search, user profile, and notifications.

animations.entrance: Use Framer Motion to stagger card entrances: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, staggerChildren: 0.1 }}
animations.charts: Animate line/area drawings using Recharts native animations.

icons.style: stroke-width 2px for standard, 1.5px for large icons.

images.bank_logos: Instructing agent to use clearbit API: `https://logo.clearbit.com/hdfcbank.com`, `https://logo.clearbit.com/icicibank.com`, `https://logo.clearbit.com/onlinesbi.sbi`

testing.guidelines: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs) and key informational metrics (Net Worth, Goals) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid='net-worth-value'`, `data-testid='add-goal-submit-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Deep Blue (#0B132B) for layout/structure, Emerald Green (#00D084) for primary actions and positive trends.
Use Outfit for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the Home Dashboard. Top-left must feature the North Star Metric (Net Worth).
Cards must use rounded-2xl with p-6 or p-8 internal padding. No dense, cramped UI.
Always format currency in Indian format: ₹ Lakh/Crore.
For the AI Coach, use the provided abstract texture with a glassmorphism overlay to make it feel premium and intelligent.
Ensure the layout is truly mobile-first (bottom navigation on mobile, sidebar on desktop).
Avoid image-heavy hero sections; this is an operational dashboard. Focus on data visualization, empty states, and actionable widgets.
Every button and clickable element MUST have a `data-testid` attribute for automated testing.
